title: A machine learning framework for the prediction of chromatin folding in Drosophila using epigenetic features.
summary: The study reports improved prediction with recurrent context and identifies Chriz and H3K4me3 as informative features. This is a genomic-data prediction result, not causal evidence that the features create chromatin domains.
ai_technology: Supervised regression, gradient boosting and bidirectional LSTM models predicted Drosophila topologically associating domain states from epigenetic features across cell lines.
organization: Faculty of Computer Science, National Research University Higher School of Economics; Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology
